data.name: Tempered Heart: Pilgrim's Mark
data.detailed_description:
NOTE: This is a skill-based RPG where precise timing and disciplined input is necessary to determine every battle. Strategy alone may not save you — you must act at the exact moment it matters. Stay focused — your enemies are cunning and relentless. Each one fights with unique attack patterns that must be learned, anticipated, and blocked in real time!

In Tempered Heart: Pilgrim's Mark, you play as Esther, a knight who has fulfilled her service to her lord and now walks the world beyond the Holy Order. Though your duties have ended, the core principles of chivalry remain. Yet the roads ahead continue to test them.

What happens when the people you meet reveal themselves to be worse than the monsters you encounter?

Watch your back — but more importantly, watch what lies ahead. The world is not as peaceful as it once was.

In your youth, you read about stories of a time long ago when peace reigned across the land. But even then, people feared something unseen. They begged for it to stop.

Someone listened.

Now monsters roam the world.

Where did they come from?
Why do they remain?

When will we be ready?

The road ahead will also test more than your strength and speed — it will test what you believe.

Battle your way through relentless hordes of enemies in this skill-based RPG. Utilize your precise timing blocks in fast-paced combat where strategy alone may not be enough. Uncover hidden truths about the world, and discover what it truly means to walk the path of a pilgrim.

Tempered Heart: Pilgrim's Mark is the first game in the Tempered Heart series.

data.short_description: Play as Esther, a retired knight journeying through a world of monsters and hidden truths. Master skill-based combat against fast and unique enemies using precisely timed blocks. Uncover the past and confront the question that has kept the world in stagnation: When will we be ready?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 (2013 4th gen) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280 x 960 Minimum Screen Resolution.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: 2.8+ GHz processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280 x 960 Minimum Screen Resolution.
